H_DEMAND.name: Declining customer demand
H_DEMAND.investigate: Check footfall by time of day, nearby competition, marketing and online reviews.

H_RETENTION.name: Weak customer retention or service quality
H_RETENTION.investigate: Review customer complaints, order accuracy, waiting time and loyalty offers.

H_PRICING.name: Pricing and discount policy eroding margins
H_PRICING.investigate: Review discount frequency, menu prices and the average bill.

H_FOODCOST.name: Rising food and ingredient costs
H_FOODCOST.investigate: Compare supplier quotes, check portion sizes and recipe costing.

H_WASTAGE.name: Food wastage and over-preparation
H_WASTAGE.investigate: Track daily unsold food and prepare according to weekday/weekend demand.

H_INVENTORY.name: Weak inventory and procurement control
H_INVENTORY.investigate: Introduce stock counts, reorder levels and first-in-first-out storage.

H_MENU.name: Low-margin menu mix
H_MENU.investigate: Cost every dish and promote high-margin items.

H_LABOUR.name: Staffing not matched to demand
H_LABOUR.investigate: Compare staff on duty with customers per day and shift.

H_CAPACITY.name: Service capacity and staff reliability problem
H_CAPACITY.investigate: Check weekend peak capacity, absenteeism and kitchen bottlenecks.

H_FIXED.name: Heavy fixed-cost burden (rent, utilities)
H_FIXED.investigate: Review rent agreement, utility usage and operating hours.

H_LIQUIDITY.name: Cash-flow and liquidity pressure
H_LIQUIDITY.investigate: Build a weekly cash forecast and a minimum cash buffer.

H_WCAP.name: Working-capital imbalance (receivables, payables, stock)
H_WCAP.investigate: Follow up overdue receivables, negotiate supplier terms, reduce stock holding.

H_DEBT.name: Debt and financing burden
H_DEBT.investigate: Review loan terms, instalment dates and interest cost.
